$comment: THE DEPLOYMENTS' COMMERCIAL FACTS. Kaana is their only source of truth (ADR 0002, amendment 2026-10-15). Each entry is published as the `commercial` member (deploymentCommercialSchema, contract set 4.4.0) of the deployment descriptor with that exact deploymentId, on the signed POST /internal/v1/deployments/query and /internal/v1/models/query. A deployment NOT listed here is not sold and its descriptor carries no `commercial`; nothing is inherited or defaulted. Changing a line is a reviewed commit. Loaded at start-up by internal/commercial (a bad file refuses to start) and validated against deploymentCommercialSchema by tools/contract/validate.mjs in `make check`. Entries stay sorted by deploymentId, without duplicates.

RULES: availabilityScope is one of platform_internal, public_payg, enterprise, byok_only, oxy_hosted; commercialPermission one of standard_application_use, public_resale_approved, wholesale_contract, customer_byok, open_weight_hosting. customer_byok if and only if byok_only. public_payg requires public_resale_approved, wholesale_contract or open_weight_hosting. dedicatedCapacity is omitted unless true (absent means shared).

IDS CARRY THE OBSERVATION DATE (dep_<provider>_<upstream>_observed_<date>): when the publisher re-observes a model under a new date the new deployment id is NOT listed and is unsold until a reviewed commit adds it. That is deliberate: a commercial permission is reviewed per deployment, never inherited.

MIGRATION: a ONE-TIME seed from a read-only export of Oxy's deployment table taken 2026-10-15 (354 rows), not a second source: from this commit Oxy's copy is retired. Only rows with permissionState approved AND status active or degraded were carried (264); the 88 retired rows and the 2 disabled/pending_review rows are not sold and are dropped. The export's status and permissionState are not carried: whether a deployment can be served now is Kaana's own inventory (withholding), and this file lists only what has been reviewed as sellable. All 264 carried rows were dedicatedCapacity false, scope platform_internal and permission standard_application_use. The legacy scope `internal_alia` (3 rows: the gpt-oss-120b deployments on cerebras, groq and openrouter dated 2026-09-01) does not exist in the contract and was mapped to platform_internal, which is what it meant (served to Oxy's own products only).

NOT SEEDED, no `commercial` (no evidence): the deployments Kaana serves that Oxy's table never held, notably OpenAI transcription (openai-audio: gpt-4o-transcribe and gpt-4o-mini-transcribe). The OpenAI Services Agreement cited in configs/public-catalogue.json assigns output to the customer (commercial use of outputs) but is not a review of the right to serve them, and their deployment ids are minted by the publisher with an observation date that cannot be known here. They stay unsold until a reviewed commit lists the exact deployment id with its evidence.

EMBEDDINGS (added 2026-10-15): dep_openrouter_qwen_qwen3_embedding_8b_observed_2026_10_15, read back from the production inventory (s3://oxy-kaana-inventory-usw2-237343248947/inventory/current.json, snapshot snap_2408959e2be05c73, issued 2026-10-15T19:49:56Z) after OxyHQ/Kaana#186 deployed. Sold on the same basis as every seeded row, platform_internal / standard_application_use: served to Oxy's own products only (Clarity's search embeddings). OpenRouter's list price for it is $0.01 per 1M input tokens (configs/public-catalogue.json, qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b).
